title: Continuing Vue 2 Usage 2+ Years Past EOL
risk_statement: Continuing to use Vue 2 when it has been End-of-Life for over 2 years exposes the application to unpatched security vulnerabilities, ecosystem abandonment, and inability to hire qualified developers.

acceptance.reason: Migration planning and resource allocation required time. Originally expected to migrate within 6 months of EOL. Now at 2+ years past EOL, migration is URGENT. This risk acceptance expires Q1 2026 - migration must begin immediately.

mitigations.detail: Implement Content Security Policy headers to mitigate XSS attacks
Run npm audit weekly to monitor dependency vulnerabilities
Subscribe to Vue.js security mailing lists and CVE databases
Execute Vue 3 migration per DEC-000018 within 6-8 weeks (by Q2 2026)
Weekly security scanning with Snyk or similar tools
Maintain emergency response plan for critical vulnerabilities
